methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in Europe at 62.08% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 28.89%, followed by Samsung Internet at 5.31%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Europe?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 62.08% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/europe.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Europe?
faqs.answer: Chrome (62.08%), Safari (28.89%), Samsung Internet (5.31%) in October 2026.
